evidence.mechanism: qualifying receipt replay identity fingerprints the complete recursively key-sorted receipt object
evidence.risk: the same evidential GUT triage receipt can evade replay suppression if a connector or transport layer adds or changes top-level delivery metadata such as receivedAt, attempt, traceId, or deliveryId; this can inflate qualifyingReceiptCount and aliasAudit without adding new evidence

requiredFix: Use a bounded replay-identity projection that removes only explicitly declared top-level non-evidential transport fields before stable structural fingerprinting. Evidence-bearing fields, nested values, arrays, provenance, classification, summary, scope, organ and status must remain significant.
adversarialRequirements: same evidence plus different top-level transport metadata must collapse as replay
changed provenance or classification must remain distinct/conflicting
nested fields with transport-like names must remain significant
cross-organ routing and contested-parent behavior must not regress
privacy: Synthetic de-identified evidence only. No private Drive name, ID, URL, or source text is included.
promotionRule: Do not promote public state until VAJRA unit/adversarial tests and cross-organ GUT/VAJRA regression pass in GitHub Actions.
